custom_css:
/* === MOBILE: UI + BODY TEXT → snpro.ttf === */

body.is-mobile,
body.is-mobile .app-container,
body.is-mobile .workspace,
body.is-mobile .workspace-split,
body.is-mobile .workspace-leaf,
body.is-mobile .view-content,
body.is-mobile .markdown-source-view .cm-scroller,
body.is-mobile .markdown-source-view .cm-content,
body.is-mobile .markdown-preview-view,
body.is-mobile button,
body.is-mobile input,
body.is-mobile textarea,
body.is-mobile select,
body.is-mobile .nav-file-title,
body.is-mobile .nav-folder-title,
body.is-mobile .status-bar,
body.is-mobile .modal,
body.is-mobile .menu {
  font-family: snpro, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif !important;
}

/* === MOBILE: HEADERS → bookerlydisplay_bd.ttf === */

body.is-mobile h1,
body.is-mobile h2,
body.is-mobile h3,
body.is-mobile h4,
body.is-mobile h5,
body.is-mobile h6 {
  font-family: bookerlydisplay_bd, serif !important;
}
